Man Drowns at Goa Beach After Being Swept Away by Wave

A 33-year-old man from Karnataka drowned at Baga beach in Goa after a large wave swept him into the sea. The incident occurred while he was reportedly sitting on a rock watching the waves. Despite attempts to swim, he was overcome by the turbulent sea, and his body was later recovered. The event was captured on video and subsequently went viral.
